name: p-simtor
description: Agent Skill: scientifically verified, interactive physics simulations as self-contained HTML instruments.

scripts.test:browser: node scripts/psim.mjs gravity --out examples/three-body/three-body.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/three-body/three-body.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/proton-magnetic-field/page.html --verify-module examples/proton-magnetic-field/physics.mjs --out examples/proton-magnetic-field/proton-magnetic-field.html && node scripts/psim.mjs check examples/proton-magnetic-field/proton-magnetic-field.html
scripts.examples: node scripts/psim.mjs gravity --out examples/three-body/three-body.html && node scripts/psim.mjs build examples/proton-magnetic-field/page.html --verify-module examples/proton-magnetic-field/physics.mjs --out examples/proton-magnetic-field/proton-magnetic-field.html
